original.description: Skipped-pattern HM twist (Law 3 footgun). The live mainnet CurveAMMAdapter 0x2D02...D6f is immutable and predates the story-052 contiguity validator; it is held as immutable ammAdapter by YieldStrategyUSDe. Any owner setRoute on it still runs the old 'last non-zero == tokenOut' check, so the sya-harvester M-01 gapped route [USDe,pool,crvUSD,0,...,sUSDe] would be accepted there, and Router NG would stop at the first gap and deliver crvUSD to the strategy (stranding value / reverting on _expected). A competent owner reading the new source would reasonably assume the check is live everywhere - surprise => footgun. Not a code defect at HEAD; an operational hazard: verify routes off-chain against the new rule before any mainnet setRoute, or redeploy adapter + strategy.
original.whyLow: Pattern applicability (centralization) is indirect; hazard is deployment-state, not HEAD code. Severity if realised could be Medium (stranded swap output on a live strategy).

original.description: minOut for share sales is derived from live vault.convertToAssets at execution. If the vault rate moves up (sUSDe reward vesting, or a donation to the vault) faster than the AMM price follows, or the AMM structurally trades the share below NAV (sUSDe cooldown discount), NAV*(1-bps) exceeds achievable AMM output and every exit/skim reverts until the owner widens tolerance. Donation-driven variant requires gifting to all vault holders (expensive for sUSDe). This is hand-off H-A; the sandwich/value-leak framing was adjudicated false-positive (M-02 d7f6c2dfd580, M-01-run12 fdda8f53151a - memory: do not re-escalate). L-22 7a66fe7d5a96 ('quoted floor not honoured') lost its premise with story-051; if this DoS variant is filed, it is a distinct root cause and needs a fresh entry with disclosure.
original.whyLow: Needs target-vault + pool behaviour (cross-contract); owner can recover via setSlippageTolerance.

original.description: Direct strategy calls vault.deposit(amount) with only a sharesReceived > 0 check and no minShares bound. If the owner-chosen target vault is empty/young and lacks virtual-share protection, a classic inflation (first-depositor donation) on the target vault rounds the strategy's shares down; the strategy then credits convertToAssets(sharesReceived), so the loss lands on the depositing client. The strategy itself mints no shares, so the literal DB signatures do not match. Strategy-level donation (sending shares to the strategy) only inflates surplus (gift), not a loss.
original.whyLow: Target vaults are owner-chosen mature vaults (autoDOLA etc.); not exploitable without an empty, unprotected target. Note CFG-01 0c12a2cfaf4b already flags a wrong autoDOLA address.

original.title: Premise change: StableStakerV2 (with the story-028 phUSD exit top-up) is LIVE on mainnet and V1 is retired. Run-17's 'V1 wired, not V2' premise is VOID, and three carried triggers have now fired.
original.description: On chain (see onChainFacts), V2 is the live client of all three strategies and runs story-028 bytecode. Each autoAnnihilate requests netWanted from the strategy, measures the delta, and MINTS phUSD for (target - delivered). Consequences for carried items: (a) L-23 e6088a0ec55e has a documented trigger, 'Under V2 the premise is VOID ... => MEDIUM'. That trigger has FIRED. My probe REFUTES the harm mechanism, though. The market _disposeShares sells convertToShares(amount), which is the NAV-equivalent of the debited principal (floored). Remaining backing per principal is therefore (V - NAV(sold))/(D - amount) >= V/D whenever V >= D, and V2's underwater guard blocks the V < D case on the voluntary path. The over-delivery comes from the AMM counterparty, not from co-clients or the skim surplus (probe: co-client backing rises, surplus unchanged). Under V2 an over-delivery mints no phUSD, because minted = target - delivered and delivered is capped at the target. V2 forwards the excess to the caller (:584-588), so it is the caller's own market gain. On mainnet a sUSDe premium over NAV is also arbitraged away by a permissionless sUSDe.deposit. Recommendation: severity-classifier re-weighs L-23 with this evidence. My suggestion is that it stays Low (or drops to QA). It should NOT escalate. (b) WATCH-17-03 is moot. stable-staker 87b34c0 [story-027] bumped lib/reflax-yield-vault to 25276b8 and stripped the preview sizing, so the preview findings (L-18..L-21, L-24, L-26, QA-10, QA-11, INFO-01, L-20, L-22) are fixed-by-removal and cannot re-arm. (c) MR-17-05 dominance is now MORE load-bearing: a cap-bind on the guarded path would become a minted phUSD shortfall, not just a false quote. Both invariants hold at HEAD. p <= D: every principal write is paired, at AYieldStrategy.sol:679/680, :711/712, :748/749, ERC4626YieldStrategy.sol:197/198 and ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy.sol:234/235; the invariant is documented at :48. a <= p: the cap is at :740-743, and the only _disposeShares call site is :745, after the cap. Line refs moved by -33 after the story-051 deletion, but the logic is byte-identical. DominanceRun17Grounding 7/7 PASS at 4788ed4. (d) Deployed-vs-HEAD divergence: the live USDe strategy predates story-047, so findings rated on HEAD's global-recipient behaviour (L-15, F-04) apply only to the USDC and DOLA strategies. The revoked OLD minter still holds 58% (3,749.6 USDe) of the commingled USDe position.
